meta.name: soot_canal_junction
meta.prompt: A soot-blackened industrial town where the railway meets the canal.

character.label: soot-blackened industrial canal and rail hub

tokens.terrain: a network of canal cuts and basins meeting a rail line and sidings through a gritty brick-and-soot mill quarter
tokens.infra: railway_tracks along the water basin; canal_locks and towpaths along the water cuts; coal_chutes over the loading quays
tokens.icons: brick mill chimneys, steam plumes, canal barges tied at the wharves, iron rail bridges over the canal
